**ID:** Bi-Vb Pc61
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)

**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 61
**Title (English, from literature):** Ordaining a pregnant woman

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Curated parallels for this rule exist in the Theravāda Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha (Pc 61) and Parivāra (Pc 61), as well as in the nun-rules of the Dharmaguptaka (Dg Bi Vb Pc 119), Mahīśāsaka (Mi Bi Vb Pc 116), and Mūlasarvāstivāda traditions preserved in Chinese and Tibetan (xct-mu-bi-vb-pc87). An English translation has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
